descriptionChirho: To have confidence, boldness, or courage, especially in relation to faith or spiritual conviction. All three clusters represent the same lexical sense across different grammatical forms (1st person singular, 1st person plural/participle, and aorist infinitive). Translations are uniform: 'confident/bold' (eng), 'tener confianza/confiando' (spa), 'ujasiri' (swa: boldness/courage), 'saahasi' (hin: courageous), 'waathiqin/atajarra'u' (arb: being confident/daring), 'damdae-hada' (kor: be bold). No semantic distinction exists between these inflectional forms.
